sentences.text: Dr. Phani Kumar, respondent in person, seeks some time to file reply.
2. The reply be filed within four weeks from today.
Rejoinder thereto, if any, be filed within two weeks thereafter.

3. Learned counsel for the parties are at liberty to file their respective written submissions before the next date of hearing, giving a chronological list of dates and events and relevant documents, if any,
alongwith duly highlighted judgments setting out the propositions of law therein, they wish to rely upon.
